name: app_flash_flush

provenance.source: exact 3.101.043 vela_ap.bin: the bes_flash MTD 0x200C8194: up_progmem_eraseblock 0xC19E7A4, up_progmem_write 0xC19E894 call this veneer (ldr.w pc, [pc] -> RAM 0x002c075f) with bank 0 and a flash offset (getaddress - 0x28000000), each inside its own BASEPRI 0x80 section followed by app_flash_flush. Same BES SDK code as the other Band 10 Pro / Band 11 images (byte-identical apart from branch offsets).

notes: BES app_flash_flush: waits until bank has no queued operation of kind (1 write, 2 erase); with none queued it returns at once, otherwise it sleeps 10 ms per round. The MTD driver queues nothing on bank 0. Called only by the pinned-start writer, with interrupts masked (BASEPRI 0x80) like the MTD driver does. Static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
